payload.summary: Write the Passages, Youth Focus and related WA service records now that their publishers are registered
payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): The publisher blocker is gone: PR #2880 (0bf2488d5) registered them (source-authority-registry.ts, catalogueIdentityOnly). The claim that Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others 'now appear in the clinical sign-off queue' is false: no Passages record exists in src/lib/services-canonical-data/ or source-acquisitions.json, and c68c6ff41 says they were deliberately absent. Next action: capture those service records and their sources. Lowered to P2 because nothing is blocked any more. PRIOR DETAIL: BLOCKER REMOVED 2026-09-18 (PR #2880, merged); THE DECISION IS STILL THE OWNER'S, which is why this row stays open. Both publishers the three WA services depend on are now registered in source-authority-registry.ts as named agencies: Department of Communities (WA) and City of Vincent. They are deliberately NOT the 'Government of Western Australia' catch-all an earlier block refused — a catch-all resolves every WA government document to one authority, whereas these two resolve only their own material. Both are catalogueIdentityOnly: true, so they are excluded from runtime retrieval classification and ranking is unchanged. WHAT IS LEFT IS THE OWNER DECISION THIS ROW ASKS FOR: registering a publisher admits no source. Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others still enter as unreviewed candidates at D band and cite nothing until signed off. They now appear in the clinical sign-off queue at /mockups/development/clinical-sign-off under Sources, which is where that decision can be worked.
